Title: Nobody 2
Writer: Umair Aleem, Derek Kolstad, Bob Odenkirk
Actors: Bob Odenkirk, Connie Nielsen, Christopher Lloyd
Plot: Suburban dad Hutch Mansell, a former lethal assassin, is pulled back into his violent past after thwarting a home invasion, setting off a chain of events that unravels secrets about his wife Becca's past and his own.
